source: Real, on CodeBuddy Code 2.180.0 on this machine's own CodeBuddy login, model deepseek-v4.1-flash, driven through weft's own agent server and this spec, every line teed (scratchpad acp12/drive.py, acp12/codebuddy/transcript.jsonl): hello; tool, with the program's tools `lookup` and `WebSearch` (the program's `WebSearch` took the built-in's place: both calls reached weft's route, each asked first, under their plain names); permission (`touch made.txt` through its Bash, allowed). From the earlier run on 2.179.3 against a local scripted model with a fake key (scratchpad adw/cblive): the answers, the replay, reject (acp_rej.jsonl) and network error (acp_neterr2.jsonl). session_info_update, available_commands_update, usage_update, config_option_update and its `_codebuddy.ai/...` notifications are left out of the real turns.
